facts.text: Ada Wong was captured in an industrial chamber equipped with high-voltage equipment and vertical spaces used by the cult to trap her.
Leon Kennedy witnessed Ada Wong being captured and felt a strong psychological impact from seeing his partner taken.
Leon Kennedy confronted Osmund Saddler at the highest crane platform of the island facility to finalize his mission.
Cornered and without his political plans, Osmund Saddler transformed into a towering multi-legged arachnid monster with a massive central eye.
Saddler's arachnid form represented the peak biological potential of the dominant Las Plagas strain.
During the battle, Saddler's arachnid form moved with superhuman speed and used its massive legs to destroy industrial equipment and isolate Leon.
Ada Wong broke free from her containment and provided Leon Kennedy with a special rocket launcher during the final battle.
Leon Kennedy used the rocket launcher to deliver a final strike to the central core of the arachnid monster, destroying it in an explosion.
The destruction of Osmund Saddler's final form ended the leadership of Los Illuminados.
Leon Kennedy felt a mix of relief and heaviness after defeating Osmund Saddler, having outplayed the most dangerous figure in the Spanish valley.
Immediately after Saddler's death, Ada Wong held Leon Kennedy at gunpoint to take the pristine dominant Plaga sample from the remains.
Ada Wong gave Leon Kennedy an apology along with the keys to an aquatic craft before escaping by helicopter.
As she flew away, Ada Wong triggered a thermal self-destruct sequence that destroyed the entire island facility.
Ada Wong intended to use the Plaga sample as leverage, recognizing that delivering it to her employer could enable a global catastrophe.
Leon Kennedy was devastated that Ada Wong took the primary evidence, realizing everyone he met in the valley had hidden agendas or contracts.
Leon Kennedy and Ashley Graham had a strict three-minute window to escape to the shoreline before the island's self-destruct sequence completed.
Leon Kennedy used an aquatic craft to bypass final security locks and escape the collapsing island facility with Ashley Graham.
The island facility was completely destroyed, erasing evidence of Los Illuminados' operations.
Ada Wong flew toward the horizon as the sun rose, having successfully secured the Plaga sample for her own employer.
